# Joypad glyphs from the Decentraland mobile explorer

`double-jump-normal.svg` and `glide-normal.svg` are copied verbatim from
https://github.com/decentraland/godot-explorer (path
`godot/src/ui/components/organisms/joypad/`, main branch, fetched 4 September 2026).
That repository is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0; the files are used here
under that licence. They are the client's own jump and glider glyphs: the scene hides the
native pad to lay out its own, and redraws the jump disc with the same pictures so a
player sees exactly what the client would have shown them.
